## 1. Guidance and results

- Q3 revenue was $3.05B (+22% y/y). GAAP EPS was $1.49 and non-GAAP EPS was $3.00. — 2026-10-20 — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035267/000103526726000067/q326ex-991earningsrelease.htm
- Results beat consensus of $2.65 EPS and $2.91B revenue. — 2026-10-20 — https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-intuitive-surgical-beats-q3-2026-estimates-shares-fall-93CH-4961251
- 2026 worldwide procedure growth guidance was narrowed to 14–15%, from 13.5–15.5%. — 2026-10-20 — https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/10/21/intuitive-surgical-isrg-q3-2026-earnings-call-transcript/
- 2026 non-GAAP gross margin guidance is 68.7%–69.3%. — 2026-10-20 — https://isrg.intuitive.com/news-releases/news-release-details/intuitive-announces-third-quarter-earnings-6
- Q3 included a $450M pre-tax antitrust settlement charge ($0.99/share after tax) and a $22M after-tax IEEPA tariff-refund benefit. — 2026-10-20 — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035267/000103526726000067/q326ex-991earningsrelease.htm
- The stock fell about 7% after hours to about $406 as investors weighed pricing and margins. — 2026-10-20 — https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-intuitive-surgical-beats-q3-2026-estimates-shares-fall-93CH-4961251
- MassDevice reported a ~10% drop, to about $393, on slower US procedure growth. It then recovered to about $425. — 2026-10-21 — https://www.massdevice.com/intuitive-stock-slides-as-us-da-vinci-procedures-slow-despite-sales-gains/
- I found no pre-announcement, withdrawal or cut in the window.

- Barclays initiated at Overweight, $485 target. The source is an aggregator and I found no primary note. — 2026-10-07 — https://tickernerd.com/stock/isrg-forecast/
- BTIG kept Buy and cut its target to $454 from $469. — 2026-10-12 — https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9118847/isrg-maintained-by-btig-price-target-lowered-to-454
- Mizuho kept Hold and raised its target to $415 from $400. UBS kept Buy with a $500 target. — 2026-10-13 — https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/isrg/forecast/
- Post-earnings, Baird raised its target to $550 from $513 (Outperform). Barclays raised to $500 from $485. JPMorgan raised to $475 from $450. Wells Fargo cut to $486 from $487. Oppenheimer kept $500. Raymond James kept Outperform at $480. — 2026-10-21 — https://www.theglobeandmail.com/investing/markets/stocks/ISRG/pressreleases/8287148/us-analyst-updates-october-21st-2026/
- Erste Group upgraded to Buy from Hold. — 2026-10-21 — https://www.tipranks.com/stocks/isrg/forecast
- Leerink raised its target to $503 from $473. — 2026-10-21 — https://rallies.ai/news/intuitive-surgical-target-price-raised-to-503-from-473-by-leerink-partners-ff6d374ae9efa735
- Raymond James's target is reported as $483→$480 by TipRanks and as $480 by Globe and Mail. — 2026-10-21 — https://www.tipranks.com/stocks/isrg/forecast
- RBC cut to $550 from $575 (Outperform). — 2026-10-21 — https://www.defenseworld.net/2026/10/28/intuitive-surgical-inc-isrg-stock-balance-wealth-partners-llc-cuts-stake.html

- Consensus target is $482.63 (stockanalysis.com) or about $493.54 (MarketBeat). — date unknown — https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/isrg/

## 3. Litigation and regulation

- Intuitive agreed to settle the "In re: da Vinci Surgical Robot Antitrust Litigation" class action for $450M plus mutually agreed injunctive relief. There was no admission of liability. The exact agreement date was not given beyond "October 2026" (date unknown), and it was disclosed on 2026-10-20. — https://isrg.intuitive.com/news-releases/news-release-details/intuitive-announces-third-quarter-earnings-6
- The settlement still needs court approval. — 2026-10-20 — https://www.massdevice.com/intuitive-stock-slides-as-us-da-vinci-procedures-slow-despite-sales-gains/
- The parallel Surgical Instrument Service Co. case is ongoing after the Ninth Circuit reversed the lower-court ruling for Intuitive. — date unknown — https://www.massdevice.com/intuitive-stock-slides-as-us-da-vinci-procedures-slow-despite-sales-gains/
- Tariffs: Section 301 duties of 10% or 12.5% on 60 trading partners took effect on 2026-07-24. IEEPA tariffs were ruled unlawful in February 2026, and refunds are being processed. — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035267/000103526726000071/isrg-20260930.htm
- Extended-use EndoWrist instruments need FDA 510(k) clearance, which is "in process". — 2026-10-20 — https://finance.yahoo.com/healthcare/articles/intuitive-surgical-isrg-said-q3-000258365.html
- Management said it submitted regulatory applications for an SP vessel sealer and an integrated da Vinci 5 endoscope. — 2026-10-20 — https://www.benzinga.com/news/26/10/62484475/intuitive-surgical-q3-2026-earnings-call-transcript
- No new FDA approvals or government investigations turned up in the window.

## 4. Customer concentration

- Nothing material found in the window. No large-customer win, loss or contract change was reported.
- China remains challenging and has hurt recent capital placements and procedure growth. — 2026-10-20 — https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/10/21/intuitive-surgical-isrg-q3-2026-earnings-call-transcript/

## 5. Insider activity (all sales under 10b5-1 plans; no purchases found)

- Director Gary Guthart's trust sold 20,095 shares at about $451.61, about $9.1M. — 2026-10-23 — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035267/000128062826000016/edgardoc.xml
- Director Craig Barratt exercised and sold 1,150 shares at $443.80. — 2026-10-23 — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035267/000127762026000009/edgardoc.xml
- SVP and Chief HR Officer Patricia Wadors sold 1,078 shares at $443.80, leaving 0 direct shares. — 2026-10-23 — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035267/000127455926000007/edgardoc.xml
- EVP Mark Brosius sold 61 shares a day on 10/26, 10/27 and 10/28 at $441.60–$451.75. — 2026-10-26 — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035267/000201030026000035/edgardoc.xml
- A Form 4 from VP and Controller Fredrik Widman, filed 2026-10-26, was listed but I didn't retrieve its contents. — date unknown — https://investor.intuitivesurgical.com/sec-filings/sec-filing/4/0001897970-26-000010
- Clustering: three insiders sold on the same day (2026-10-23), right after the earnings-related price rebound.

## 6. Product and competitive news

- Pricing: Intuitive finalized price cuts on a subset of high-volume benign procedures. Together with China policy changes, they should cut da Vinci instruments and accessories revenue per procedure by about 3–5% once fully implemented. The cuts roll out from 1H27, and management doesn't expect the full impact until end of 2027. — 2026-10-20 — https://finance.yahoo.com/healthcare/articles/intuitive-surgical-isrg-said-q3-000258365.html
- China instrument price cuts begin in Q4 2026 (November, per the call), under the national pricing framework. — 2026-10-20 — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035267/000103526726000071/isrg-20260930.htm
- Placements: 546 da Vinci systems were placed (+28%), including 315 da Vinci 5. Installed base is about 12,094 systems. — 2026-09-30 — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035267/000103526726000071/isrg-20260930.htm
- Single-port procedures grew 55%. Ion procedures grew 31%. — 2026-10-20 — https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-intuitive-surgical-beats-q3-2026-estimates-shares-fall-93CH-4961251
- US da Vinci procedures grew 10% against a 16% prior-year comparison. Outside the US they grew 20%. — 2026-10-20 — https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/10/21/intuitive-surgical-isrg-q3-2026-earnings-call-transcript/
- Management announced a new manufacturing facility in Malaysia. It expects several telesurgery regulatory clearances in 1H 2028. — 2026-10-20 — https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/10/21/intuitive-surgical-isrg-q3-2026-earnings-call-transcript/
- No new competitor launches or clearances (Medtronic, J&J, others) turned up in the window.

writeup.headline: Intuitive Surgical rates Hold: strong growth and quality offset by weak trend and absolute valuation.
writeup.thesis: Intuitive Surgical scores 61, a Hold, 4 points below the Buy band. Quality is the strongest factor at 85, with a 67.2% gross margin, 28.4% operating margin, 31.1% FCF margin and diluted share count down 2.8% year on year. Growth scores 74 on TTM revenue growth of 20.4% and latest-quarter revenue growth of 21.7% year on year, with growth sped up by 3.2 pp from the previous quarter. Valuation scores 48: in absolute terms the multiples are high, at 13.3x sales and 42.8x FCF, with the FCF yield 2.7 pp below the 10-year Treasury yield, though the stock is cheap against its own history (P/FCF cheaper than at 59 of the last 61 month-ends). The trend score of 38 holds the rating back, with shares down 25.2% from 12 months ago to 1 month ago and price 25.1% below its 52-week high.
key_risks: Price cuts and China pricing are expected to reduce instruments and accessories revenue per procedure by about 3–5%.
US procedure growth slowed to 10%, which could weigh on future revenue growth.
The valuation is high in absolute terms at 42.8x FCF, leaving little room for disappointment.
The $450M antitrust settlement still needs court approval, and the separate SIS case continues.
Weak relative performance, with shares 11.2 pp behind SPY over the last 126 trading days, and insiders selling after earnings.
what_would_change: A 4-point gain in the composite score would move the rating to Buy, for example through a recovery in the trend factor from its score of 38.
Further growth acceleration or an improving valuation score from 48 could also push the score into the Buy band.
A drop of 17 points or more would be needed for a Sell, such as a sharp slowdown in revenue growth alongside margin pressure from pricing cuts.
Clarity on the balance sheet, currently unscored, could shift the composite in either direction.
